working_definition: Author type 'TEv' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_term: ventral transient extrinsic neuron of pupal optic lobe
best_match.fbbt_definition: A transient extrinsic neuron whose cell body is located on the ventral side of the optic lobe. It expresses Wnt4 (FBgn0010453) (Ozel et al., 2021).

justification: 'TEv' is an exact synonym of FBbt:00058014 'ventral transient extrinsic neuron of pupal optic lobe', a pupal type defined from this paper; the same term at every stage it occurs.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058014 'ventral transient extrinsic neuron of pupal optic lobe' (exact match).
